name: Moon Priest: Huntress Shot applies 2 additional Scattered Stars in Lunar Eclipse (#345)
contract: The report (level 10 Starcaller, Moon Priest selected) expects Huntress Shot to apply 2 stacks of Scattered Stars and sees 1. Two shipped tooltips state the numbers: Moon Priest 92134 reads "Your Huntress Shot now has a Lunar Eclipse effect. Huntress Shot: Applies 2 additional Scattered Stars", and Huntress Shot 680220 reads "Applies 1 Scattered Star" with, under $?s92134, "Lunar Eclipse: Applies an additional Scattered Star" (singular, a disagreement between the two records that this scenario does not resolve). The code (AscensionStarcallerAbilities.cpp, hit callback) always applies 1 star and adds 2 only when the Lunar Eclipse snapshot 800386 was set on the cast (spell->GetScriptValue(800386)), which needs Moon Priest known, Lunar Phase at 4 stacks with aura 704519 and a cast of Lunar Eclipse 800386 before the shot. The reporter's steps never activate Lunar Eclipse, so the base result of 1 star is what the shipped tooltip promises there. The scenario therefore pins the two numbers the data does state: without Lunar Eclipse one Huntress Shot leaves exactly 1 Scattered Star (804378) owned by the caster on the target, and with Lunar Eclipse active it leaves 1 plus the 2 additional of the Moon Priest tooltip, 3. It cannot show that 2 (the reporter's figure) is intended: the only source for it is the singular/plural conflict above. Both fixtures know Moon Priest, Lunar Eclipse and Huntress Shot rank 1 (680220), have raised hit ratings, stand at the same spot facing +X with a hostile creature 15 yd ahead and carry a bow in the ranged slot (Worn Shortbow 2504, item_template row of the shipped repack dump, class 2 subclass 2, inventory type 15) because the spell requires an equipped weapon of subclass mask 262156. Lunar Phase stacks are set with set_aura 802985 x4 plus 704519 for the Eclipse fixture only; Lunar Eclipse's cast consumes them (IsLunarEclipseActivation). The cast is 2.0 s (SpellCastTimes idx 5), hence the waits. Class 26 bow proficiency is not verified. If equipping the bow is rejected the runner reports the inventory error before any assertion, which is a fixture problem and not a result.
